entities.name: Precinct Three
entities.description: A lush, community-focused region of the Tenth District of Ravnica, the main source of fresh food and livestock, shaped by the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: District of Ravnica containing Precinct Three.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane supplied with food by Precinct Three.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild that nurtures the greenery of Precinct Three and trains its watch captains.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Guild whose raids occasionally cause unrest in Precinct Three.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose patrols sometimes aid Precinct Three watch captains.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild whose abandoned buildings are in Concordance and which funds the Museum of Ravnica.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Giant tree and massive living guildhall of the Selesnya at the northern edge of the precinct.

entities.name: Beast Haven
entities.description: Western neighborhood of stables and paddocks.

entities.name: The Canopy
entities.description: Northern quarter with homes built among tree branches.

entities.name: Concordance
entities.description: Eastern neighborhood with moss-covered abandoned Orzhov buildings.

entities.name: Great Concourse
entities.description: Raised roads linking Selesnya communities, doubling as a market.

entities.name: Ivory Oaks
entities.description: Stand of massive trees guarded by albino Loxodon warrior-priests.

entities.name: Velen's Rest
entities.description: Place plagued by aggressive giant spiders.

entities.name: Museum of Ravnica
entities.description: Public museum housed in Vitu-Ghazi, funded by the Orzhov, opened after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Glaive of the Guildpact
entities.description: Artifact on display in the Museum of Ravnica.

relations.quote: Located in the northeastern part of the Tenth District
its massive living guildhall, Vitu-Ghazi , stands proudly at the precinct's northern edge
the Gruul Clans occasionally intrude from the wilds, often stirring up trouble when they do
sometimes aided by Boros Legion patrols when needed
